scope: Actual FBX binary skin clusters, hierarchy and animation connections; actual Unity generated mesh vertex streams; no simulation or implementation edits.

generatedMesh.boneNameResolution: All bone hashes exactly matched CRC32 of full FBX model hierarchy path

capeBoneHierarchy.interpretation: Cape upper bones are children of Chest. Hips is an ordinary torso ancestor via Spine/Chest; legs and feet are separate branches, not Cape ancestors.

runClip.interpretation: 108 exported Cape scalar curves (12 bones x translation/rotation/scaling XYZ), 25 samples each across 0.8 seconds. All effectively constant: rotation spread <= 0.00001526 degrees; smaller ranges are floating-point export noise, not an authored Cape run swing.

vertexCountExplanation: FBX Cape has 556 source control points. Unity expands UV/normal seams to 789 render vertices. Native Cloth welds these duplicates back to 556 particles in the saved demo. Counts refer to different representations.

proposedRearHemRegressionSelection.rule: back chain summed weight >= 0.75 and normalized height from top >= 0.65

sceneHierarchyOverrides.note: No per-bone reparent overrides found in saved scene. This report inspects saved source/assets, not runtime procedural pose.

directionRegressionRecommendation.steadyRun: Use controller scripted input for world +Z; begin evaluation once player forward dot world +Z > .99 and at least .4 seconds of steady run.
directionRegressionRecommendation.targetMetrics: Same summaries for current skinned anchors; distinguish target bending forward from native physics deviation.
directionRegressionRecommendation.defaultComparison: Compare native steady-run mean z against native idle mean z; determine a margin that fails the current reproduced bug and passes the intended repair.
directionRegressionRecommendation.parameterBoundary: Repeat direction/leg-clearance envelope during existing strongest-wind phase with actual run input; angle limits alone do not prove hem direction.
directionRegressionRecommendation.limitations: A direction envelope does not prove cloth-foot triangle nonintersection. Do not compare absolute world z displacement to judge trailing direction.
